s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of the nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

shortlist.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches symptoms of nasal mass and facial swelling in a teenage patient

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Biopsy results showing spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells

shortlist.label: Fibrous dysplasia
shortlist.why_kept: Bony changes with remodeling and thinning, and presence of a heterogeneous mass

shortlist.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a heterogeneous mass with solid and cystic components

shortlist.label: Ossifying fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Matches symptoms of facial swelling and nasal septum deviation

shortlist.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of a mass in the maxillary sinus with erosion of surrounding structures

shortlist.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Aggressive nature of the tumor with erosion of surrounding structures

shortlist.label: Rhabdomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Rare but possible diagnosis given the age of the patient and aggressive nature of the tumor

raw.rationale: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells and rare mitotic activity, along with the absence of cytologic atypia, are consistent with a giant cell tumor. The clinical presentation and imaging findings of a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with bony erosion and remodeling also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Juvenile nasopharyngeal angiofibroma
rejected.why: Typically occurs in adolescent males and is characterized by intense vascular staining, which is not mentioned in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Fibrous dysplasia
rejected.why: Usually presents with ground-glass appearance on imaging and does not typically show a heterogeneous mass with significant multinucleated giant cells on biopsy

rejected.label: Aneurysmal bone cyst
rejected.why: Typically presents with fluid-fluid levels on imaging and has a distinct histological appearance with blood-filled spaces, which is not described in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Ossifying fibroma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a well-defined, calcified mass on imaging and has a distinct histological appearance with ossification and fibrous tissue, which is not described in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Esthesioneuroblastoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a mass in the nasal cavity and has a distinct histological appearance with neuroblastic cells, which is not described in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Sinonasal undifferentiated carcinoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a highly aggressive and infiltrative mass on imaging and has a distinct histological appearance with malignant cells, which is not described in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Rhabdomyosarcoma
rejected.why: Typically presents with a highly aggressive and infiltrative mass on imaging and has a distinct histological appearance with malignant rhabdoid cells, which is not described in the biopsy results
